description.summary: Forming holy auras, lights, and sprites between your hands you thrust them forwards as they explode into a soft swirl of auroras.
description.value: Forming holy auras, lights, and sprites between your hands you thrust them forwards as they explode into a soft swirl of auroras. The aurorastorm creates a 30ft radius of varied-colour auroras that both increase the light level by 2 steps (darkness becomes normal light, dim light and normal light become bright light) and have a chance to affect any light, healing, and dark school spells. Any time a spell with the light, healing, or dark schools is cast within or into the aurorastorm roll a d100, if it lands between 1 – 33, the damage/healing is increased by 10% if holy or healing, and reduced by 10% if dark. If any creature is currently affected by an effect that produces light, like by a torchlight cantrip, the chance of it activating for them increases to 1 – 50. Aurorastorm counters and dispels spells of equal or lower level that reduce the light level of an area like blacklight . Aurorastorm can be countered and dispelled by equal or higher level spells that reduce the light level of an area. This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for February 2021 by DeadKingKicker.
